_readme: Partial GT: Barrick Carlin 2024 page 17 (Table 1-1 Mineral Resources Summary, 100% Basis), hand-transcribed from the printed page and re-verified line by line.
_units: grade in g/t Au, metal in Moz Au; report config: data/reports/barrick.config.json
_corrections_vs_v1: REMOVED 4 rows labelled 'Underground': on page 17 that row is printed as 'Underground' / '<12 numbers>' / 'Total' - it is the Underground Total AGGREGATE, not a deposit. Old GT (and the extractor) both treated it as a deposit.
ADDED the Indicated rows that the old GT (and extractor) silently dropped: Open Pits Indicated 120/1.99/7.9 and Carlin Stockpiles Indicated 32/2.34/2.4.
Field names migrated to the neutral schema (grade/grade_unit/metal/metal_unit); the old grade_gpt/contained_moz names are still accepted by evaluate.py.
_warning: This page reports the same deposits as the few-shot example (page 191 Table 14-21), so these numbers are partly present in the extractor prompt. Use barrick_p192_gt.json for leak-free capability evidence.
